messages:
Carlos Mendes: Morning! On my first day and hit a weird chain of delays. Okta account shows active, but I never got the Google Workspace inbox (no welcome email) and 1Password invite didn’t arrive either. MFA in Okta is stuck at 'Complete profile'. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
it-provisioning-bot: Provision summary: okta_user_created carlos.mendes@redwood.com at 2026-05-02T08:05:12Z; google_account_create_initiated at 2026-05-02T08:05:45Z; 1password_invite_queued.
Priya Patel: Welcome Carlos! Usually the Workspace welcome can take a couple minutes. Can you confirm you tried logging into mail.google.com with carlos.mendes@redwood.com and that it shows an account exists? Also check spam folder for the 1Password invite.
Carlos Mendes: Tried logging and it says 'Account not found' when I input the @redwood.com email. Okta portal still shows me as provisioned though.
Samir Rao: Sometimes the provisioning webhook to Google stalls if the directory API quota spikes. Priya, can you check the provisioning job status for carlos.mendes?
Priya Patel: Looking now... I see the create job hit a 429 from the Directory API at 08:06:00Z. It retried and succeeded at 08:10:40Z but the welcome email worker failed to pick up the success event. I can kick the welcome email and requeue the 1Password invite.
Jules K.: FYI if you don't get the mailbox but Okta exists you can still access most internal apps via SSO. 1Password invite may be delayed because our invite worker reads from the same event stream. Priya, manual requeue would help.
Priya Patel: Requeued welcome email and 1Password invite at 08:12:00Z. Also manually added carlos.mendes@redwood.com to group 'eng-ml' so you have Drive/team access while the inbox propagates.
Carlos Mendes: Thanks  I just tried sign-in to Drive and it still prompts for an account. Tried incognito and no luck yet.
Samir Rao: Group add should be immediate for folder access, but Drive caching can cause hiccups for a couple of minutes. If you still get a sign-in loop, try clearing cookies or check that you aren't signed into multiple Google accounts in the browser.
Carlos Mendes: Ok tried incognito after a few minutes  Drive opened and I can see team folders. 1Password invite still not in spam though.
Priya Patel: 1Password worker shows invite delivered at 08:12:05Z to carlos.mendes@redwood.com. It sometimes lands in Gmail categories (Promotions) or corporate filters. If you still don't see it in 15m I'll manually resend a one-time link.
Carlos Mendes: Nothing yet. Is there a way to fetch a direct invite link?
Priya Patel: I can generate a one-time provisioning link and DM it to you. Also, for Okta MFA if it says 'Complete profile' go to Profile -> Setup Extra Verification Methods and either register a passkey or TOTP now. If you prefer TOTP use an authenticator app like Authy/Google Authenticator.
Carlos Mendes: Quick MFA Q: I want to use TOTP in Authy. Anything special for seed input?
Samir Rao: No special seed. In Okta choose TOTP -> 'Set up Authenticator App', scan the QR or copy the secret and paste into Authy. Save backup codes from Okta after enrolling.
Jules K.: GitHub invite will follow separately; SSH key needs to be added manually. Example to generate: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "carlos.mendes@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Carlos Mendes: Got the one-time 1Password link via DM from Priya  accepted and set a master password. Also registered TOTP in Okta, saved backup codes. All good now. Thanks everyone for the quick responses! :tada:
